summary: This clinical study is testing a drug called zenagamtide in adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease, which is a condition of long-term kidney damage. Researchers want to see how well the medicine lowers blood sugar and body weight compared to a placebo, which is an inactive treatment that looks like the real drug. Participants are assigned to receive either zenagamtide or a placebo by chance. The trial is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S.
